target: Bract PO:0009055 is sometimes absent: presence varies. Bracts, where present, are arachnoid on the abaxial side (context 'abaxial'). No taxon-wide absence.

target: Lower glume PO:0006002 absent (PATO:0000462). The subacute apex belongs to the remaining (upper) glume, so glume PO:0009039 is present.

target: Septum PO:0000030 lacks all parts of type (PATO:0002000) vascular bundle PO:0005020, i.e. a veinless septum. Fruit valve PO:0000033 is about 3-veined (vascular bundle present on the valve).

Map them to <part> + lacks all parts of type vascular bundle, never to a taxon-wide 'vascular bundle absent'. Keep the bearer of any vein count ('valves 3-veined') as that part.
reason: In Brassicaceae the septum and the valves are different parts of the silique. A veinless septum and veined valves occur together normally.

target: Drop it. 'Specialized asexual reproduction not seen' is about gemmae or propagula (gemma PO:0025614), not leaves, and 'not seen' is not an absence. The hyaline leaf tip (leaf apex PO:0020137, hyaline) stands.

target: Style PO:0009074 absent in the ray flowers (context: ray flower PO:0025331). The disc flowers have a style bifid at the apex.

target: Lateral (external) bracts on the fig receptacle wall are absent (bract PO:0009055 with context 'lateral, on the receptacle'). The basal or ostiolar bracts are present and submembranous.

reason: Ficus figs carry up to three bract sets: basal, lateral and ostiolar. The statements describe different sets.

target: External or lateral bracts around the ostiole are absent (bract PO:0009055, context 'external, at the ostiole'). The ostiolar or basal bracts present are suborbicular.

reason: The suborbicular bracts are a different bract set (basal or ostiolar) from the external ones said to be absent.

target: Petal PO:0009032 sometimes absent (context 'sometimes'). Where present, the petals are linear.

target: The lower (basal) leaves are bladeless sheaths: scale leaf PO:0006003 or leaf sheath PO:0020104 with the context 'basal' (FLOPO:0991002). Leaf lamina PO:0020039 of the other leaves is present and scabrous (FLOPO:0991058) on the margin and veins.

target: Lenticel PO:0000031 absent on the branches (rameaux). The feminine singular 'un peu lenticellée' belongs to another bearer, probably the bark or the stem (écorce or tige): lenticel present there, sparse.

reason: The two statements agree with different nouns (masculine plural vs feminine singular), so they describe different parts.

target: Probably two branch orders or ages: one 'non lenticellés', the other 'indistinctement lenticellés'. Check the source for which branches each describes. 'Indistinctly lenticellate' means lenticel present but inconspicuous (PATO:0000464).

target: 'Without leaves' describes a leafless flowering branch or inflorescence (inflorescence PO:0009049, context 'without leaves'), not the plant. Vascular leaf PO:0009025 is present, and the blade (leaf lamina PO:0020039) is slightly coriaceous.

target: Lateral bracts on the fig receptacle are absent (bract PO:0009055, context 'lateral'). The apical (ostiolar) bracts are present: 5, erect.

target: Drop it, or record a cystolith absence if a cystolith class is added later. The leaf lamina PO:0020039 is present and ± scabrous (FLOPO:0991058). There is no PO or FLOPO class for cystoliths.

target: The inner surface of the fig receptacle is glabrous: fruit PO:0009001 (or the fig receptacle), context 'inside' (inner side), glabrous PATO:0000453. Equivalently, trichome PO:0000282 is absent inside. The fruit is present and subglobose.

target: Bract PO:0009055 is eglandular (negated glandular PATO:0002117); the glands on the bract are absent (portion of secretory tissue PO:0005656 absent). The bract is present, with an incised margin.
